questions.prompt: Which sea did Moses part according to the biblical account of the Exodus?
questions.fact: The Hebrew phrase is closer to sea of reeds, which some scholars think points to marshland rather than open water.

questions.prompt: Which layer of the Sun do we actually see from Earth?
questions.fact: Light made in the core takes tens of thousands of years to fight its way out to this layer, then eight minutes to reach us.

questions.prompt: Which winter sport involves sliding head-first down an ice track?
questions.fact: Riders reach around 130 km/h with their chin a few centimetres above the ice, steering mostly by shifting their shoulders.

questions.prompt: Which film won the Academy Award for Best Picture in 1994?
questions.fact: Its two main rivals that year are now more highly rated by audiences than the winner.

questions.prompt: Which sea is the world's largest inland body of water?
questions.fact: Whether it counts as a sea or a lake is a live legal question, because the answer changes how its oil is divided.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Things Fall Apart's most famous African successor, Half of a Yellow Sun?
questions.fact: It is set during the Biafran war, which her own parents lived through and rarely spoke about.

questions.prompt: Which part of a computer permanently stores the operating system?
questions.fact: Solid state drives replaced spinning disks largely because they have no moving parts to fail or wait for.
